findings.title: ADR 0023 withheld writer/anchor table was false for two of eight reasons, and the partition-is-exactly-RenderWithholdReason claim was false — following it would stamp occurred_at, the single retention clock, with a render timestamp
findings.reason: Round 2 verified every cell of the replacement writers-not-reasons table against the code. RenderWithholdReason (outreach.ts:525) and OutreachWithheldReason (dispatch.ts:149-155) intersect in exactly {lint_failed, moderation_high}, which is the row marked BOTH; render_failed is written only by ask-generation.ts (:425, :1699) and rendered_at is NOT NULL (091:210) with no assignment anywhere in src/ or worker/; commitWithhold (dispatch.ts:1365-1380) sets agent_run_id in the same UPDATE. The ADR citations dispatch.ts:149-155 and :254-255 resolve exactly at HEAD, and dispatch.ts is not a file this change edits. The #1009 occurredAt claim resolves against issue #1009 verbatim. One residual gap is recorded separately as RT-13.

findings.title: C5 all_refusal_codes IS NOT NULL and cardinality(...) > 0 are provably redundant — zero differing rows over the whole value space — so no row pins them
findings.reason: Deliberate defence in depth, not dead weight. The two clauses at supabase/migrations/116_refusal_events.sql:160-161 are redundant only GIVEN the sibling clauses that currently stand; each states one fact the reader needs, and removing them would let a later edit to array_position or to C4 silently widen the constraint. The same reasoning applies to C5 outer IS TRUE, which RT-03 showed is equally unreachable by any row and which is now pinned STRUCTURALLY rather than deleted.
